audience: small businesses and freelancers who send invoices from Zoho Invoice

useCases.title: Review unpaid and overdue invoices
useCases.text: List invoices, filtered by status, customer or date range, with totals and balance. Open one invoice to see its line items and payments.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and its details
useCases.text: Search customers by name, company or email. Open one customer to see its billing address and payment terms.

useCases.title: Find the items to put on an invoice
useCases.text: List the products and services with their rates, descriptions, taxes and units. Use them as line items on an invoice.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice for a customer
useCases.text: Create an invoice as a draft with its line items. The draft is not sent and the customer is not emailed, so check it first.

useCases.title: Send a checked invoice to the customer
useCases.text: Mark a draft as sent, or email the invoice to one or more addresses with an optional PDF. An email cannot be recalled.

useCases.title: Cancel a sent invoice
useCases.text: Void an invoice that was sent. It stays in the books with a void status and no balance due.
